commitResults.messageTitle: Add error handling for invalid inputs
Improve AI and UI testing guidance
Merge Level 7 save and load with Level 6 delete

commitResults.messageBody:
SamSquare mixes console input and response formatting with command
validation and task changes, making each responsibility harder to follow.

Move input, the greeting, task responses, errors, and farewell into an
instance-based Ui. Let SamSquare coordinate that object and close its
input when the session ends. Preserve all existing response wording.

Record the greeting in the UI test plan and require an isolated storage
directory so saved personal tasks cannot affect empty-list tests.

Validate on Java 25 with all 13 console cases and 47 commands. The full
transcript matches the baseline exactly, including whitespace.

This is the first A-MoreOOP iteration; Parser and TaskList extraction
remain before the assignment completion tag can be applied.

SamSquare mixes text recognition and argument validation with task
changes, obscuring the distinction between parsing and execution.

Introduce a Parser for each input line to recognize commands, create
validated tasks, and parse task numbers without touching list state.
Keep execution, range checks, display, and saving in SamSquare for this
iteration. Preserve existing whitespace rules and error messages.

Expand the UI plan to cover whitespace-only arguments, integer overflow,
command boundaries, and successful commands with padded arguments.
Record these previously missing checks in the test-ui guidance.

Validate all 16 UI cases and 82 commands on Java 25. The complete console
transcript matches the pre-refactoring baseline exactly.

This is the second A-MoreOOP iteration. TaskList extraction remains
before applying the assignment completion tag.

SamSquare directly owns an ArrayList and validates task numbers, mixing
collection rules with command coordination.

Move task ownership, add/delete operations, completion changes, and
number validation into TaskList. Copy loaded collections and provide
unmodifiable collection snapshots for display and saving so callers
cannot add or remove tasks through the backing list.

Return loaded tasks from Storage and accept the List interface when
saving. Preserve the existing file format, console responses, and
handling of missing files and malformed saved lines.

Extend the UI plan and testing guidance with stale task numbers, empty
lists, and restarts that verify task types, order, completion status,
and changes made to loaded tasks.

Validate all 20 UI cases and 112 commands across four processes on
Java 25. The full console transcript matches the baseline exactly.

Complete the minimum A-MoreOOP target with Ui, Storage, Parser, and
TaskList. Command subclasses remain an optional stretch goal.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract list and exit command classes
commitResults.messageBody:
SamSquare performs every command itself, keeping command behavior tied
to the application's dispatch loop.

Introduce an abstract Command with execute and isExit methods. Move
listing and farewell behavior into ListCommand and ExitCommand, and let
Parser construct these objects. Dispatch the extracted commands through
the shared contract while retaining the existing path for task changes.

This intentionally keeps the first stretch-goal iteration small. The
remaining task-changing commands can adopt the same contract next,
allowing the temporary split in dispatch to be removed.

Extend the console plan to reject list and bye with trailing spaces.
Validate all 20 UI cases and 116 commands across four sessions on Java
25, with an identical console transcript before and after extraction.

SamSquare still performs task changes directly while list and exit use
Command subclasses, leaving two execution paths in the main loop.

Extract AddCommand, DeleteCommand, MarkCommand, and UnmarkCommand. Each
command performs its task change, displays the response, and saves the
updated list. Use one AddCommand for all three existing task types.

Have Parser construct every executable command and keep argument
parsing private. Reduce the application loop to parsing, execution,
exit detection, and error reporting through the shared Command API.

Extend the UI plan with an immediate restart after each mutation type.
Earlier reload checks could mask missing saves through later commands;
record this gap and its required check in the testing guidance.

Validate 25 UI cases and 129 commands across nine sessions on Java 25.
The complete console transcript matches the pre-refactoring baseline.
This completes the A-MoreOOP command-class stretch goal.

Deadline dates are arbitrary strings, so impossible dates are accepted
and the app cannot distinguish stored values from presentation.

Parse ISO dates into LocalDate and display English month names. Keep
saved dates in ISO format and report invalid command dates without
changing task state. Skip unparseable old saved deadlines with a notice
and preserve the original file in a unique backup before saving.

Add calendar, locale, persistence, and legacy-data console cases. Commit
the reusable UI runner so a fresh checkout can repeat the checks.

Validate all 30 UI cases and 159 commands on Java 25, including exact
backup verification and reloads under a French default locale.

Users must scan the full list to locate a task. Add FindCommand and a
TaskList search operation that returns case-sensitive substring matches
in their original order without changing or saving the task list.

Parse non-empty search text and display matching tasks with consecutive
result numbers. Explain that modification commands still use full-list
numbers. Include find and delete in the unknown-command help message.

Validate 33 UI cases and 185 commands on Java 25, covering all task types,
empty input, no matches, phrases, case sensitivity, substring matches,
unchanged task order, deletion, and searches after reload.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document task APIs and private helpers
commitResults.messageBody:
The original task and exception classes lack JavaDoc headers, leaving
their contracts less clear than the newer command and parser classes.

Document all remaining declared classes, constructors, and methods.
Explain completion state, description search, event text times, date
representation, task-number validation, and legacy-data backups.
Add generation instructions for the API reference.

Audit headers on 18 classes and 72 declared constructors/methods.
Generate private-inclusive JavaDoc with documentation lint and warnings
treated as errors. Exclude missing-comment lint for generated default
constructors, fields, and packages; review source header coverage
separately.

Confirm that Java executable source is unchanged and rerun all 33 UI
cases and 185 commands on Java 25 with an identical console transcript.
Complete both the minimal and stretch A-JavaDoc requirements.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a brief SamSquare user guide
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the placeholder with concise feature instructions, command formats, and examples. Explain dates, search numbering, and saved tasks so users can operate SamSquare without reading the source.

Trim leading and trailing input whitespace before recognizing commands
so padded commands behave like their unpadded equivalents. Preserve
internal description spaces and continue rejecting extra arguments.

Update the User Guide and console test plan for the new behaviour.
Teach the test runner to verify termination for padded exit commands
and record this requirement in the UI testing guidance.

Validation: all 35 console cases and 207 commands pass on Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix User Guide formatting on GitHub Pages
commitResults.messageBody: Describe surrounding spaces in prose because the Pages renderer leaves padded inline backticks visible. Record the observed difference from local Markdown previews in the documentation guidance.

Let users find completed and incomplete deadlines with on yyyy-MM-dd
by comparing stored dates, without changing tasks or saved data.

Document the command and cover invalid dates, leap days, whitespace,
and state changes through the console UI tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command names and banner into constants
commitResults.messageBody:
Centralize command names in Parser to keep recognition and dispatch
consistent. Move the greeting artwork into a Ui constant to keep
showGreeting focused on displaying the welcome message.

Preserve existing console behaviour, verified by all 39 UI test cases
covering 258 commands.

Keep the product documentation in one User Guide so users do not need
to consult separate increment notes. Preserve search, saving, and
backup recovery details in docs/README.md.

Remove the redundant date and find guides and the developer-facing
Javadoc generation notes from docs.
